model_scope: Paper Eq.(7) budget, not a runtime or success guarantee for the simulated circuit.

assumptions.c: Manually supplied color count; default 2112 is empirical 12r.
assumptions.nP: Manually supplied phase-synthesis cycles; default 27 is illustrative, not Table III cubic NT=24.
assumptions.TLC: d QEC rounds at the paper-assumed 1 microsecond per round.
assumptions.success: Instance-average 8-SAT model from the cited study; not the toy circuit probability.

note: Eqs.(10)-(11) are main-text approximations, not exact integer schedules. TACU, phase synthesis, factories, routing, training, resets and readout are not simulated. The robust factor is a paper protocol budget; the protocol is not implemented.
